show.description: When seven successful siblings Aarav, Kabir, Vivaan, Raghav, Meera, Riya, and Ananya turn against their foster father Maheshwar Nath, believing shocking lies about their past, they destroy his life and careers in blind rage. But when the truth of betrayal surfaces, the family faces a storm of guilt, revenge, and redemption, testing the very meaning of blood and love. Watch Now!
